title: MIRROR: Multimodal Intelligent Radiology Reasoning and Observation Reporter
abstract: arXiv:2608.16709v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A radiologist reading a model's output faces two problems. The model returns a number and no reason, and any system that turns that number into readable prose can quietly add claims the model never made. MIRROR is a research prototype built to separate those failures. It chains a multi-label classifier, a Grad-CAM localizer that turns each positive finding into a named anatomical region, and a report writer that receives the labels, probabilities, and regions but never the image. Because the language layer cannot see pixels, it cannot assert a finding the classifier did not make. We are precise about what that buys: a MIRROR report's findings are auditable against the probability vector, while the sentences framing them are ordinary generated text, and we show one stating a cardiothoracic ratio the system never measured. translated_title: MIRROR：多模态智能放射学推理与观察报告生成器
translated_abstract: 放射科医生在阅读模型输出时会面临两个问题。模型返回一个数字但不提供理由，而任何将该数字转换为可读文本的系统都可能悄悄添加模型从未做出的声明。MIRROR是一个研究原型，旨在分离这些失败。它串联了一个多标签分类器、一个将每个阳性发现转换为命名解剖区域的Grad-CAM定位器，以及一个接收标签、概率和区域但从不接收图像的报告编写器。由于语言层无法看到像素，它不能断言分类器未做出的发现。我们精确地说明了这带来的好处：MIRROR报告中的发现可以对照概率向量进行审计，而构成这些发现的句子是普通的生成文本，我们展示了一个陈述系统从未测量的心胸比率的例子。一个注册表保存了胸部X光、脑部MRI和头部CT的分类法、解剖结构和措辞，因此添加一种模态只需……
tldr: MIRROR通过将分类、定位和文本生成分离，确保报告中的发现可审计且不会引入模型未做出的声明。
en_tdlr: MIRROR separates classification, localization, and text generation to ensure findings in reports are auditable and free from claims the model never made.
